prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: refined HLP Labs portfolio illustration in a finished 7:5 landscape composition.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is ONLY the user's approved rendering benchmark for warmer, clearer, more lively ink-and-paper craft.
KEEP these elements from image 1: the single glass research-vial character with its same glass body silhouette, round stopper and neck rings, pie-cut eyes and delighted smile; its two attached rubber-hose arms, two white gloves, two legs and shoes; the same small rectangular tray it is holding level in its raised right-side hand; and the pointing gesture of its left-side hand aimed at the specimen slide on the microscope. Retain the classic microscope beside it and the logical pointer-to-slide relationship. The existing vial character is the star and must remain recognizable. The face is drawn directly on transparent glass, no opaque white face patch, no face sticker, no separate circle or oval panel. No human or humanoid person.
Improve the scene around that action with deliberate laboratory detail: a beautifully inked black-enamel microscope with coherent eyepiece, tube, rotating objective nosepiece, a visible glass slide secured on its flat stage, precise focus knobs and curved support. The pointing fingertip is clearly near the slide but does not touch an objective or pass through any object. The held specimen tray has clean shallow raised edges and two tidy flat microscope slides resting inside; no mysterious cubes or food.
Replace the overly busy museum/shop-window cabinet on the right with a more compact, orderly laboratory specimen cabinet in the same general position, slightly behind the vial. It has small wood drawers below and a neat rack of a few capped glass research vials visible through the upper glass. REMOVE the seashells, starfish and fossil collection. The image should communicate organized lab research and samples, not a curiosity shop. The tray remains unobstructed and separate from the cabinet.
Craft and atmosphere: give the vial clear, controlled glass reflections around its perimeter and believable refraction at its base, darker confident main contours, pleasant subtle expression, clean glove folds, shoes with small ink highlights, carefully chosen wood grain and a warm pool of light from the existing upper-right task lamp. Retain the tall arched window and a faint shelf of simple laboratory glassware as quiet background depth. Fewer background containers, no clutter at the front edge, no extra machines. Main character, hands, tray and microscope remain high-contrast; the distant lab stays soft and pale.
Match input 2's confident sculptural hand-inked contour, rich black fills, attractive warm ivory paper and neutral gray wash. Add life through lighting, material detail and a clear stage of action, not through excessive scratch marks or stippling. This is a lovingly drawn 1930s cartoon cel with a real environment. No 3D plastic, photorealism, all-over grunge or heavy brown stains.
Composition: keep the vial, microscope and held tray as a compact clear group near center, with the quieter cabinet behind them to the right. Full 7:5 rectangular image, comfortable margins, complete microscope base and character shoes visible. No baked border, rounded corners, black vignette, circular frame, text, words, letters, numbers, labels, logos or watermark. Exactly ONE living character. No needles, injection equipment or treatment scene.
